name: Hyperbeam

modes.label: HD participant-hour
modes.note: 60×$0.007 per participant-minute; not per VM-hour. Graduated monthly volume discounts unmodeled. Unspecified guest OS is not a selectable OS guarantee.

plans.name: Pay as you go
plans.note: 10,000 free participant-minutes/month = $70 base-rate equivalent. Shared allowance; never subtract again as free.monthly_credit.

features.ip_note: Sessions run in NA/EU/AS regions on mixed server providers with no fixed IP range; bring your own HTTP proxy via PAC file (WebRTC not proxied); no managed proxies.
features.browser_profile_retention: Profiles not accessed for three months expire and are automatically deleted.

caveats: Storage, snapshot GiB-month and public IPv4 prices are not published in the reviewed sources; null is not free.

No guaranteed vCPU allocation published; browser-hour is not a verified 4-vCPU/8-GiB VM equivalent. The sizes card keeps unknown hardware null; do not coerce it to zero or auto-rank against resource-guaranteed VMs.
Browser RAM is not published unless a specific mode overrides it.

Calculator counts all participants, not just participants after the first. One browser watched by three people can incur three participant streams. Headless use with zero watchers has no verified tariff.
Embedded save states, multi-user control and WebGL are documented; no separate storage/proxy/CAPTCHA tariff found. Machine resource guarantees are unpublished.

fleet.verification: Introductory monthly usage explicitly no card.
fleet.notes: Participant-minute credits and shared-session participant counts are not concurrent VM quotas. No exact new-account session fleet cap/raise process located.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages
